summary: Approved Material 3 redesign across SalesDrone with responsive navigation, filled forms, independent lead activity/details, accessible icon toolbars and cursor-based infinite lead scrolling.

api.reason: Presentation-only redesign retains API contract 1.16, field IDs, stored preferences and business mutations; no cosmetic API endpoints are added.
api.permissions: Existing Google/App Check, active membership, lead scope, PAT scopes and private Storage access remain authoritative. The separate local admin fixture has no API transport.

manualVerification: Actual isolated Chromium review with fictional guest/admin fixtures: 360/390/600/768/1024/1280/1440/1920px lead list with no page overflow; automatic 30/60/90/96 demo paging and stable selection; 440/520/720px inspector toolbar; full lead tabs and memory-only attachments; filled 56px forms on desktop/phone; light/dark Book palettes; public Swagger only. All 26 affected screenshots refreshed and reviewed. Physical device, production signed-in writes and live cursor failure/identity race browser simulation were not performed. Full local tests and Firebase emulator integration are recorded separately from CI/post-deploy evidence.
